title: thunderbird keeps asking for a password before sending email
creator: mgold3
content:
I'm trying to re configure Thunderbird, to avoid the constant requests for passwords each time I try to send an email. My server sent me a link to a discussion of this problem, which listed several possible solutions to the problem. #3 and #4 did not solve my problem.

  1. 2 suggests I delete the Tbird files logins and logins.json. I followed the procedure:

Menu/help/troubleshooting information/profile folder/open folder.

I found the two files, but I cannot delete them because "the files are still open". Where do I go from here? Please reply via email [redacted from community support forum] @pathcom.com
